question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

He is the director's **favourite boy**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"director's favourite boy"** means someone who is highly favored or preferred, especially by someone in authority. (निर्देशक का पसंदीदा लड़का)

 
 
• **Example: **He is always given the best projects because he is the **director's favourite boy.**
 
 
 
• **"Blue eyed boy" **refers to someone who is the favorite of a person in power, often receiving special treatment or privileges. (चहेता लड़का)
 
 
• **Example: **John is the** blue eyed boy** of the company, always getting the best assignments.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Break a leg **(शुभकामनाएं): A way to wish someone good luck, especially before a performance.

 
 
• **Example:** "Break a leg!" she said to her friend before the play started.
 
 
 
• **Above board **(ईमानदार): Open, honest, and legal.
 
 
• **Example: **All their business dealings are above board.
 
 
 
• **Good old boy** (पुराना अच्छा लड़का): A man who embodies traditional or conservative values, often used in a friendly or nostalgic context.
 
 
• **Example:** He's a good old boy who loves his family and his country.
 
 

38:Tbb7,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.<
